name: UOB Visa Signature Card
highlights: 4 miles per S$1 on Overseas Transactions (including Online)
4 miles per S$1 on Petrol, Contactless Transactions
4 miles per S$1 on SimplyGo Transactions
Up to UNI$10 per S$5 spend (4 miles per S$1 spend) on Overseas Transactions (including online)
Up to UNI$10 per S$5 spend (4 miles per S$1 spend) Petrol Spend and/or Contactless Transactions
Up to UNI$10 per S$5 spend (4 miles per S$1 spend) on SimplyGo transactions (using Contactless payment)
Waiver of first year annual fee
Earn UOB$ cashback on all purchases in-store at over 1,000 participating merchants(across all categories islandwide) and use it to offset your next purchase

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: 1st Supplementary Card free, S$ 109.00 for subsequent Supplementary Cards

our_takes.our-take: The UOB Visa Signature Card is a strong miles-earning card for disciplined spenders who can consistently meet its monthly spend requirements. Its key draw is the ability to earn up to ~4 miles per S$1 equivalent on overseas, contactless, petrol, and eligible online spend—making it well-suited for frequent travellers and commuters who want to convert everyday spending into air miles. However, the value drops sharply if you miss the qualifying thresholds or exceed monthly caps.
our_takes.good-for:
Miles chasers with consistent monthly spending
Travellers who spend frequently overseas or online
Contactless and petrol spenders
Daily commuters using SimplyGo
our_takes.things-to-note:
You need to meet a monthly spend threshold to unlock bonus miles; otherwise, earn the lower base rate
Bonus miles are capped each statement month—extra spend earns less
FX fees (~3.25%) apply on overseas transactions despite bonus miles
Spend is tracked by statement cycle, not calendar month
UNI$ expire and can be affected by account adjustments
